title.zh: 如何使用自建探测探针自动化监控机场节点在线率（SLA）与延迟突变？
title.en: Automating Proxy SLA & Latency Spike Monitoring with Self-Hosted Probing Scripts

cluster.zh: 机场跑路前兆与稳定性监测集群

description.zh: 教你用一行脚本或轻量开源探针（Uptime Kuma / Python）全天候 24 小时监控订阅节点的在线率、TCP 握手时延与丢包率，并在节点故障时自动向微信/Telegram 发送报警。
description.en: Deploying lightweight open-source monitoring probes (Uptime Kuma / Python) to audit proxy node SLA, TCP handshake latencies, and packet loss 24/7 with instant Telegram/Bark alerting.
